output.title: Renovated 4-Bedroom Penthouse with Panoramic City Views in Belair
output.description:
This spacious 220 m² penthouse offers a refined living experience in the upscale Belair neighborhood. Recently renovated, the residence features a bright and open-plan living room adorned with oak parquet flooring and a wood-burning fireplace, complemented by floor-to-ceiling windows that provide abundant natural light and expansive views over Luxembourg City. The integrated smart-home lighting system enhances comfort and convenience throughout the space.

The kitchen is equipped with professional-grade Gaggenau appliances and presents a sleek, minimalist design with a Carrara marble island and matte black fixtures. An integrated wine fridge adds to the culinary appeal, while the large central island creates a generous space for entertaining.

Accommodation includes four bedrooms and three bathrooms. The master suite features a walk-in closet, ensuite bathroom, and private access to a terrace. This terrace, along with the main expansive terrace, offers south-facing exposure with composite decking and outdoor lounge areas enclosed by glass balustrades, allowing for unobstructed 180-degree vistas of the city.

Additional amenities include elevator access, a parking space, and a separate cellar for storage. Located in Belair, a green and exclusive residential neighborhood characterized by elegant villas and quiet tree-lined streets, the property benefits from proximity to the city center while enjoying a tranquil setting.

highlights.text: Professionally equipped kitchen with Gaggenau appliances
Wood-burning fireplace in open-plan living area
South-facing terraces with panoramic city views
Elevator access and parking space included
